ThingDef.label: ruptured wraith growth vat
ThingDef.description: The split remains of a Wraith biological cultivation vat. Its nutrient membranes have collapsed and the control tissue is dead, leaving only a decaying shell that hints at whatever was being grown here.

ThingDef.label: collapsed wraith feeding rig
ThingDef.description: A dead restraint-and-transfer cradle from an abandoned Wraith laboratory. Torn conduits, calcified restraints and dried nutrient channels show that living subjects were once held here for feeding or experimentation.

ThingDef.label: calcified wraith gestation cocoon
ThingDef.description: A dead Wraith gestation shell from a population-production complex. Layered membranes and caste-shaping nutrient channels have mineralised around an empty central cavity. Whatever growth cycle once occurred here ended long ago.

ThingDef.label: collapsed wraith clone manifold
ThingDef.description: The dead distribution organ of a Wraith cloning installation. Thick vascular trunks once divided cultured biomass and tailored nutrient chemistry between multiple gestation bays; the channels are now dry, split and useless.

ThingDef.label: drained wraith donor dais
ThingDef.description: A calcified transfer cradle where a living Wraith donor once contributed life force to gestation cycles. The restraint ribs remain, but the transfer tissue has collapsed into brittle cords and cannot function.
